latestVersion.changelog:
AI Image to Video APK — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: convert static images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC) up to 200MB into animated 1080p MP4 videos.
- Cloud GPU-based processing, with typical exports ready in 30–60 seconds.
- Seamless interaction: auto-connects to API, handles anonymous tokens and session management.
- Supports user prompts for exporting videos, checking credits, uploading files, and editing timelines.
- Exports compatible with major platforms; handles error codes and guides users through common issues.
- Designed for TikTok creators and anyone needing fast, high-quality video from still photos.
